originality.rationale: The final claim is implication-covered. The classical Coven-Meyerowitz theorem characterizes integer tiles whose cardinality has at most two prime factors; cardinality three is its simplest prime case, and the all-complement formula follows by elementary residue-class splitting. On the spectral side, the currently published complete cyclic three-point spectral-pair theorem at modulus 3g gives all spectra; quotienting common translations yields exactly the g squared normalized real spectra. The audited theorem packages these consequences but does not add a nonstandard lemma.
